fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or fence-line gate across any truck driveway. Multiple curb-cuts from W 16th St lead directly into yard / dock aprons. Confirmed in Street View along the entire south frontage (2024-06 capture).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed booth visible at any truck entrance. Office facade on 16th St (red 'Heinz 57' sign building) is a normal admin entry, not a guard checkpoint.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all (not because there is a gate with kiosk).
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Truck driveways from 16th St are short — less than two truck lengths from curb to either the dock apron or the east drop-yard. A queue of 3+ trucks would not fit inside.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Yard is hard up against 16th St with very little stacking room — a truck queue on a busy day would spill onto a public street. An XTRA-Lease trailer was already observed staged on the curb in the 2024-06 Street View.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: With no formal gate, in/out flow uses the same handful of curb-cut driveways.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Each curb-cut is roughly one truck-width inbound, one outbound; estimated single-lane each way per driveway.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted from satellite: ~12 trailers backed against west dock face of NW building, ~9 trailers along south face of central building, ~12-15 doors on east face serving east drop yard. Banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large eastern drop yard holds 50-65 trailers in 5-6 visible rows in the captured imagery; band 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on different building faces (west dock vs south dock vs east dock) consistent with separated ship/rcv operations in a multi-line food plant; some uncertainty without internal floor map.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the City of Holland's dense urban fabric: immediately south across 16th St are dense residential blocks, marina, retail. Classified Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified on the property in any probed imagery.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot east of the plant, physically separated from active dock aprons.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur visible in NE corner imagery curving in from the east-side ROW into the north tank-field — site is rail-served.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Four distinguishable building masses: (1) NW building west of the central road-corridor, (2) central main process building (Heinz 57 facade), (3) southeast / south dock building, (4) north tank-process structure along the shoreline.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Computed from perimeter bbox: ~245 m N-S x ~405 m E-W ≈ 24.5 acres.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Counted as 2 main truck curb-cuts off W 16th St (one west near the Heinz 57 office facade, one east near the drop yard); no actual gates, but 2 dominant truck-flow access points.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: All four building masses are tightly contiguous on one parcel — read as a single integrated facility rather than a multi-building campus.
